intro: Imported tags often differ only in surrounding whitespace or letter case. Cleaning before deduplication lets equivalent labels share one identity while preserving the first-seen ordering.
task: Strip and lowercase tags, discard blanks, preserve first occurrence.
requirements: Return a list of stripped, lowercased nonblank string tags. Keep only the first occurrence after normalization.
Sequence inputs are Python lists or tuples of at most 1000 items. Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Normalize each tag before deciding whether it has already appeared.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Skip a tag whose stripped form is empty; do not remove internal spaces.
